families.name: MUSITU Axiom
families.intro: MUSITU Axiom brings specialized mathematical operations into intelligent analytical workflows. It focuses on structured quantitative work whose inputs, methods and results can be examined.
families.evidence: Documented published ChatGPT integration v2.0.4; later corrections and broader enterprise features remain separate engineering work.
families.limits: No live trading, promised financial outcome, independent superiority certification, unrestricted enterprise account service or generally available integrated billing is established.

families.name: MUSITU Education
families.intro: MUSITU Education develops and investigates software intended to make revision, knowledge and interactive learning more accessible and purposeful.
families.evidence: Chemistry Rescue pages and Chemistry Mastery release notes are public; current release notes document signed Android version 1.3.0.
families.limits: No official examination-board endorsement, guaranteed academic outcomes, claimed school adoption or unrestricted institutional product launch.

families.name: MUSITU Foundry
families.intro: Foundry explores digital production, three-dimensional software and engineering systems that transform ideas into interactive assets.
families.evidence: An 82-second captured Studio recording and GLB reviewer notes document 13 meshes, 13 nodes, 13 materials and one animation clip.
families.limits: Not a general-availability enterprise 3D editor, GPU-rendering cloud, completed Gemini-to-3D workflow or integrated Studio–Axiom pipeline.

families.name: MUSITU Markets
families.intro: MUSITU Markets explores the foundations of market-facing technology: useful discovery, structured catalog information and responsible software distribution.
families.evidence: Store V2 architecture research exists, but an unrestricted public marketplace release has not been established.
families.limits: No licensed retailer, authorized checkout service, general payment processor or publicly operational unrestricted marketplace is claimed.

families.name: MUSITU Frontier Market Intelligence
families.intro: Frontier Market Intelligence studies quantitative approaches to changing market information, uncertainty and risk-aware financial analysis.
families.evidence: Technical research and experimental model work are documented in controlled development records, not as a public production trading system.
families.limits: No broker execution, autonomous live trading, proven returns, licensed investment advisory service or current predictive guarantee.

families.name: MUSITU WorldFabric
families.intro: WorldFabric investigates how digital systems can communicate, exchange information and coordinate workflows within defined operational boundaries.
families.evidence: Controlled MUSITU Connect runtime work is documented; commercial general availability is not established.
families.limits: No unrestricted enterprise deployment, telecommunications network, autonomous payment fabric or generally available cross-product operating layer is claimed.

evidence.title: Published Axiom integration
evidence.claim: Axiom has a documented published ChatGPT integration.
evidence.establishes: A published integration release was recorded and separately distinguished from development-stage changes.
evidence.limits: Does not establish current app-listing access, enterprise general availability, independent superiority certification or trading.

evidence.title: Chemistry Mastery public release
evidence.claim: Chemistry Mastery release notes identify Android version 1.3.0.
evidence.establishes: The official product pages publicly described version 1.3.0 as the stable signed Android release on the review date.
evidence.limits: Public-page retrieval does not constitute downloading or independently validating the installed package. No guaranteed academic outcomes.

evidence.title: Studio offline editing and GLB export
evidence.claim: An authentic offline Studio demo shows scene manipulation and animated GLB export.
evidence.establishes: A recorded sequence shows camera manipulation, object creation, keyframe animation and an exported GLB artifact.
evidence.limits: No generally available cloud/GPU service, Gemini-to-3D pipeline or connected Axiom–Studio production runtime.

evidence.title: Markets research boundary
evidence.claim: Markets investigates digital-product discovery and commerce architecture.
evidence.establishes: A development and research direction is documented within the canonical family portfolio.
evidence.limits: Does not establish an operating marketplace or authorized checkout.

evidence.title: Frontier market research boundary
evidence.claim: FMI investigates risk-aware quantitative market analysis.
evidence.establishes: A bounded research direction and controlled technical studies are documented.
evidence.limits: No live broker execution, proven returns or public trading authority.

evidence.title: WorldFabric controlled integration research
evidence.claim: WorldFabric includes documented controlled interoperability research.
evidence.establishes: A software integration and infrastructure research direction exists, with controlled Connect runtime records.
evidence.limits: Does not establish unrestricted commercial availability, authorized communications or live payment services.

evidence.title: Existing MUSITU Intelligence experience
evidence.kind: Public page and historical test evidence
evidence.claim: An existing public Intelligence experience is available at its separate origin.
evidence.establishes: Public website content was successfully retrieved during the editorial review; historical application tests document bounded features.
evidence.limits: Public page reachability alone does not retest every current AI inference, document workflow or local storage feature.
